title: Signature Boundary Cartographer
description: Signature original — the signature cartographer of generalization: every boundary mapped, every edge marked. The map guides deployment. Limits get navigated.

demo.code:
print("mapped: shift edges (cartographer!)")
print("navigated: limits")
ind, ood = 95.0, 72.0
gap = ind - ood
print("in-dist %.1f%% ood %.1f%%" % (ind, ood))
print("generalization gap: %.1f points" % gap)
assert gap >= 0
print("gap measured")

title: Signature Concept Detective
description: Signature original — a detective for concept shift: the broken mapping is found. The detective is thorough. Models get retrained wisely.

demo.code:
print("found: broken mapping (detective!)")
print("retrained: wisely")
scores = [0.91, 0.87, 0.12, 0.89]
threshold = 0.5
ood = [s for s in scores if s < threshold]
print("ood flagged:", len(ood), "of", len(scores))
assert len(ood) == 1
print("detection verified")

title: Signature OOD Sentinel
description: Signature original — a sentinel for the unknown: the flagging is vigilant. The sentineling protects. Trust gets guarded.

demo.code:
print("flagged: OOD (vigilantly!)")
print("guarded: trust (sentinel!)")
groups = {"a": 92, "b": 88, "c": 71}
worst = min(groups, key=groups.get)
print("group accuracies:", groups)
print("worst group:", worst, groups[worst])
assert groups[worst] == 71
print("worst-group measured")
